"""Exact value-profile book publication, unchanged capacity and native rendered guidance."""
import argparse
import json
import subprocess
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, REVISION, need, pin, save

CHAPTER = Path('docs/book/src/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.md')
REGISTRY = Path('doctrine/live_document_size/surfaces.jsonl')
ANCHOR = 'The complete finite raw-address and numerical/source parent acceptance is now\nqualified.'
ADDITION = 'Complete source-value parent acceptance is now qualified. Independent direct\nsource traversal joins every original obligation to a complete value or phase,\nwith all schemas, member order, argument roles and inherited inner operands.\nWhole predicate, scalar and authored regex products conserve their qualified\nsource and evidence roles.\n\nEvery source-neutral public construction retains its complete selected plan,\ndriver and actual native receipt. The receipt must authenticate that exact\nplan and driver; an intervention plan cannot substitute for the main fixture\nplan. Current public profiles determine only their qualified construction\nalternatives. They supply no original formatter setting, native flag, encoding,\nidentity or private meaning.\n\nThe source do operation remains distinct from its diagnostic require marker.\nWhole original receiver/reference, private framework and eval evidence remains\nopaque. Source-first selection and each complete original parent and child\ncontract conserve. Fresh prerequisites execute in their qualified current-source\nor fixed committed-publication context, with complete results retained.\n\nReplay the complete source-value parent and genuine whole controls:\n\n```sh\nscripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh -- python3 -B docs/audits/observer-source-value-acceptance-20261011/verify.py\n```\n\nThis closes the source-value parent only. Full source-generated original headers\nare the next separately owned step; original raw-header comparison, higher\nobserver/private/native and visual acceptance remain open.\n\n'


def git(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(['git','--no-replace-objects',*args],capture_output=True)
    need(result.returncode == 0 and not result.stderr,'whole fixed book authority')
    return result.stdout


def aggregate(rows):
    return dict(files=len(rows),lines_total=sum(r.count(b'\n') for r in rows),bytes_total=sum(map(len,rows)))


def source():
    names = sorted(name for name in git('ls-tree','-r','--name-only',REVISION,'--','docs/book/src').decode().splitlines()
                   if Path(name).parent == Path('docs/book/src') and name.endswith('.md'))
    before = {name:git('show',REVISION+':'+name) for name in names}
    need(before[str(CHAPTER)].decode().count(ANCHOR)==1 and ADDITION not in before[str(CHAPTER)].decode(), 'unique source-value parent guide source seam')
    after=dict(before)
    after[str(CHAPTER)]=before[str(CHAPTER)].decode().replace(ANCHOR,ADDITION+ANCHOR,1).encode()
    return before,after


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--publish',action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--native',action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--native-output',default='book-native.json',choices=['book-native.json','book-native-final.json'])
    args=parser.parse_args()
    before,after=source()
    current={str(p):p.read_bytes() for p in Path('docs/book/src').glob('*.md')}
    if args.publish:
        need(current==before, 'publish only the owned sole source-value parent book addition')
        CHAPTER.write_bytes(after[str(CHAPTER)])
        rows=[json.loads(line) for line in REGISTRY.read_bytes().splitlines()]
        authority=next(r for r in rows if r.get('surface_id')=='shipped_behavior')['reference_contract']
        a,b=aggregate(list(before.values())),aggregate(list(after.values()))
        authority['aggregate_change']=dict(authority_id='OBSERVER-SOURCE-VALUE-ACCEPTANCE-20261011',
            owner=(BASE/'scope.txt').read_text().splitlines()[0],baseline=a,
            delta={key:b[key]-a[key] for key in a},
            rationale='Document complete unchanged source-value parent acceptance, original obligation and whole public construction bindings while retaining inherited evidence and original native/settings/private and higher header/raw boundaries.')
        REGISTRY.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True)+'\n' for r in rows))
        save('book-publication.json',dict(revision=REVISION,addition=ADDITION,
            before={k:pin(v) for k,v in before.items()}, after={k:pin(v) for k,v in after.items()},
            authority=authority['aggregate_change']))
        print('PASS exact sole source-value parent book addition and fresh aggregate authority; capacity ceilings unchanged.')
    else:
        need(current==after, 'entire current source-value parent book publication and complete unchanged peers')
        if args.native:
            class Text(HTMLParser):
                def __init__(self):
                    super().__init__();self.parts=[]
                def handle_data(self,data):
                    self.parts.append(data)
            raw=Path('docs/book/book/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.html').read_bytes()
            reader=Text();reader.feed(raw.decode())
            rendered=ADDITION
            expected=' '.join(line for line in rendered.splitlines() if not line.startswith('```'))
            need(' '.join(''.join(reader.parts).split()).count(' '.join(expected.split()))==1,
                 'whole unique rendered source-value parent guide')
            save(args.native_output,dict(chapter=pin(raw),addition=pin(ADDITION.encode()),
                scope='Whole native guidance text and source custody only; visual book QA remains open.'))
        print('PASS complete current source-value parent guide and source publication; visual QA remains separately owned.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Complete external gate receipts; expected diagnostics remain visible."""
import json
import fcntl
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, canonical, need, pin


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv)>=3, 'named check and explicit command')
    name,command=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2:]
    path=BASE/'checks.json'
    lock_path=Path('.artifacts/observer-source-value-acceptance-20261011/checks.lock')
    lock_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
        need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
    inputs={str(p):pin(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(BASE.glob('*.py'))}
    inputs.update({arg:pin(Path(arg).read_bytes()) for arg in command if Path(arg).is_file()})
    result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
    # Commands may run independently; only this short read/merge/write is
    # serialized. Reload after the child so an older invocation cannot erase
    # a receipt completed while it was running.
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
        need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
        saved[name]=dict(command=command,status=result.returncode,stdout=result.stdout,stderr=result.stderr,inputs=inputs)
        path.write_bytes(canonical(saved))
    print(name,result.returncode,result.stdout[-1400:],result.stderr[-1800:],flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode==0,'external check success: '+name)

"""Independently conserve the complete book source set and every prior ceiling."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, REVISION, canonical, load, need, pin, same, save
import book


def git(*args):
    actual=subprocess.run(['git','--no-replace-objects',*args],capture_output=True)
    need(actual.returncode==0 and actual.stderr==b'','complete fixed publication source custody')
    return actual.stdout


def aggregate(data):
    return dict(files=len(data),lines_total=sum(x.count(b'\n') for x in data),bytes_total=sum(map(len,data)))


def main():
    need(sys.argv[1:] in ([],['--current']),'explicit dated or current publication role')
    names=git('ls-tree','-r','--name-only',REVISION,'--','docs/book/src').decode().splitlines()
    before={name:git('show',REVISION+':'+name) for name in names
            if Path(name).parent==Path('docs/book/src') and name.endswith('.md')}
    after=dict(before)
    need(before[str(book.CHAPTER)].decode().count(book.ANCHOR)==1,'unique complete book publication seam')
    after[str(book.CHAPTER)]=before[str(book.CHAPTER)].decode().replace(book.ANCHOR,book.ADDITION+book.ANCHOR,1).encode()
    report=load('book-publication.json')
    need(report['revision']==REVISION and report['addition']==book.ADDITION
         and report['before']=={k:pin(v) for k,v in before.items()}
         and report['after']=={k:pin(v) for k,v in after.items()},'whole sole source-value parent guide change')
    original=[json.loads(line) for line in git('show',REVISION+':'+str(book.REGISTRY)).splitlines()]
    expected=json.loads(json.dumps(original))
    authority=report['authority'];a,b=aggregate(list(before.values())),aggregate(list(after.values()))
    need(authority['authority_id']=='OBSERVER-SOURCE-VALUE-ACCEPTANCE-20261011'
         and authority['owner']==(BASE/'scope.txt').read_text().splitlines()[0]
         and authority['baseline']==a and authority['delta']=={k:b[k]-a[k] for k in a},'exact fresh book authority')
    next(r for r in expected if r.get('surface_id')=='shipped_behavior')['reference_contract']['aggregate_change']=authority
    metrics=load('publication-metrics.json')
    task=next(r for r in expected if r.get('surface_id')=='task_evidence')
    for dimension,value in metrics['task'].items():
        need(type(value) is int and value>0,'complete typed task measurement')
        allowance=task['baseline'][dimension]+task['transition']['max_growth'][dimension]
        if value>allowance:
            task['transition']['max_growth'][dimension]=min(value+task['transition']['ratchet_step'][dimension],
                task['enforcement_ceilings'][dimension])-task['baseline'][dimension]
        need(value<=task['baseline'][dimension]+task['transition']['max_growth'][dimension]
             <=task['enforcement_ceilings'][dimension],'measured task growth within unchanged ceiling')
    need(same(task,metrics['task_declaration']),'whole independently measured task declaration')
    need([r.get('enforcement_ceilings') for r in original]==[r.get('enforcement_ceilings') for r in expected],
         'every original capacity ceiling conserves')
    if sys.argv[1:]:
        need(expected==[json.loads(line) for line in book.REGISTRY.read_bytes().splitlines()],
             'every prior surface and Knowledge Map authority conserves')
        paths=sorted({p for pattern in task['targets'] for p in Path('.').glob(pattern)})
        data=[p.read_bytes() for p in paths]
        actual=dict(files=len(data),lines_total=sum(x.count(b'\n') for x in data),bytes_total=sum(map(len,data)),
            lines_each=max(x.count(b'\n') for x in data),bytes_each=max(map(len,data)),
            line_bytes_each=max(len(line.rstrip(b'\r')) for x in data for line in x.split(b'\n')))
        need(actual==metrics['task'],'complete actual current task dimensions')
        need({str(p):p.read_bytes() for p in Path('docs/book/src').glob('*.md')}==after,'complete current book source membership and bytes')
    proof=dict(before=pin(git('show',REVISION+':'+str(book.REGISTRY))),after=expected,
        scope='Sole exact book authority and measured task allowance; every prior surface/ceiling/Knowledge Map authority unchanged.')
    if (BASE/'publication-proof.json').exists():
        need(same(load('publication-proof.json'),proof),'whole immutable source-value publication proof')
    else:

"""Retain every actual command, stream and complete program epoch, including failures."""
import subprocess
import sys
from common import BASE, canonical, need, pin, save


def execute(label, command):
    previous = list(BASE.glob('actual-' + label + '-*.json'))
    name = 'actual-' + label + '-' + str(len(previous) + 1) + '.json'
    programs = {str(p):dict(identity=pin(p.read_bytes()), body=p.read_text())
                for p in sorted(BASE.iterdir()) if p.suffix in ('.py', '.pl')}
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
    record = dict(command=command, status=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout,
                  stderr=result.stderr, programs=programs)
    save(name, record)
    print(name, result.returncode, result.stdout[-500:], result.stderr[-1000:], flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0 and not result.stderr,
         'actual complete successful step: ' + name)
    return record


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv) >= 3, 'label and explicit command required')
    execute(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:])

"""Independent complete source-value parent and unchanged-contract qualification."""
import base64
import copy
import gzip
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, CENSUS, PREDICATE, SCALAR, REGEX, BOUNDARY, REVISION, SCOPE, canonical, fixed_inputs, load, need, pin, read, same, save
import contracts
import prerequisites
import value_oracle


def expected():
    source=read(CENSUS/'source-models.json')
    predicate=read(PREDICATE/'predicate-values-qualified.json')
    scalar=read(SCALAR/'scalars.json')
    regex=read(REGEX/'regexes.json')
    values=value_oracle.source_expected(source,predicate,scalar,regex,read(REGEX/'plan.json'))
    obligations={}
    for name,resolutions in values['obligations'].items():
        obligations[name]=[]
        for resolution in resolutions:
            rows=values['operands'] if resolution['resolution_kind']=='operand' else values['phases']
            value=rows[resolution['resolution_index']]
            need(value['path']==resolution['path'],'independent whole obligation/source-member allocation')
            obligations[name].append(dict(resolution=resolution,value=value))
    # Read each entire fixture/driver/public contract independently. Prior
    # constructor readers qualify their native meaning; this join conserves
    # every byte and never reinterprets a current capture as original settings.
    public={}
    for kind,directory in [('predicate',PREDICATE),('scalar',SCALAR),('regex',REGEX)]:
        public[kind]=dict(
            plan=read(directory/('fixture-plan-qualified.json' if kind=='predicate' else 'plan.json')),
            native=read(directory/('native-qualified.json' if kind=='predicate' else 'native.json')),
            driver=(directory/('native-qualified.pl' if kind=='predicate' else 'native.pl')).read_text())
        if kind=='predicate':
            public[kind]['intervention_plan']=read(directory/'native-control-plan.json')
        if kind!='scalar':
            public[kind]['public_contracts']=read(directory/'public-contracts.json')
    public['meaning']='Whole qualified source-neutral public constructions only; no current fixture supplies an original setting, native identity or private meaning.'
    return dict(scope=SCOPE,source_values=values,obligations=obligations,predicate=predicate,scalar=scalar,regex=regex,
        public_constructions=public,dependencies={str(p):pin(p.read_bytes()) for p in fixed_inputs()},
        source_selection=read(BOUNDARY/'source-selection.json'),
        original_opaque=dict(source='separately retained whole original boundary evidence',
            identity=pin((BOUNDARY/'opaque-evidence.json').read_bytes()),semantic_oracle=False,
            native_identity='unmeasured',private_meanings='unmeasured'),
        next_scope='Full source-generated original headers remain separately owned; no original raw-header comparison occurs here.')


def constructor_bindings(public):
    for kind,directory in [('predicate',PREDICATE),('scalar',SCALAR),('regex',REGEX)]:
        fixture=public[kind]
        plan=pin(canonical(fixture['plan']))
        driver=pin(fixture['driver'].encode())
        native=fixture['native']
        if kind=='predicate':
            need(native['plan']==plan and native['driver']==driver,
                 'actual whole native plan/driver binding: '+kind)
        else:
            need(native['inputs'][str(directory/'plan.json')]==plan
                 and native['inputs'][str(directory/'native.pl')]==driver,
                 'actual whole native plan/driver binding: '+kind)


def validate(product,task_contracts):
    wanted=expected()
    need(product['scope']==SCOPE,'unchanged complete source-value acceptance scope')
    need(set(product)==set(wanted),'closed complete source-value product fields')
    for kind in ('predicate','scalar','regex'):
        native=product['public_constructions'][kind]['native']
        need(type(native['status']) is int and native['status']==0 and native['stderr']=='',
             'typed whole public constructor success: '+kind)
    constructor_bindings(product['public_constructions'])
    for field,value in wanted.items():
        need(same(product[field],value),'entire independent source-value parent field: '+field)
    need(same(task_contracts,contracts.derive()),'complete unchanged source-value parent/child/header contracts')
    return dict(product=pin(canonical(wanted)),contracts=pin(canonical(task_contracts)),scope=SCOPE)


def falsify(product,task_contracts):
    result=[]
    def trial(name,mutate,cause):
        p,c=copy.deepcopy((product,task_contracts))
        mutate(p,c)
        need(not same([p,c],[product,task_contracts]),'genuine complete hostile parent candidate')
        try:
            validate(p,c)
        except ValueError as error:
            need(str(error)==cause,'intended parent control failure: '+name+': '+str(error))
            result.append(dict(name=name,cause=cause,status='rejected',
                candidate_gzip_base64=base64.b64encode(gzip.compress(canonical(dict(product=p,contracts=c)),mtime=0)).decode()))
        else:
            raise ValueError('accepted hostile source-value parent: '+name)
    field=lambda name:'entire independent source-value parent field: '+name
    trial('omitted-source-member',lambda p,c:p['source_values']['operands'].pop(),field('source_values'))
    trial('reordered-source-members',lambda p,c:p['source_values']['operands'].reverse(),field('source_values'))
    trial('wrong-whole-source-expression',lambda p,c:p['source_values']['operands'][0]['input'].update(role='borrowed'),field('source_values'))
    trial('wrong-whole-source-schema',lambda p,c:p['source_values']['operands'][0].update(schema='borrowed'),field('source_values'))
    name=next(iter(product['obligations']))

def custody():
    qualified=load('prerequisites-qualified.json')
    first=load('prerequisites.json')
    extension=load('prerequisites-input-extension.json')
    need(set(first['fixed'])==set(qualified['fixed'])-{str(PREDICATE/'fixture-plan-qualified.json')}
         and all(first['fixed'][k]==qualified['fixed'][k] for k in first['fixed'])
         and first['readers']==qualified['readers']
         and extension['fixed']=={str(PREDICATE/'fixture-plan-qualified.json'):qualified['fixed'][str(PREDICATE/'fixture-plan-qualified.json')]}
         and extension['first']==pin(canonical(first)) and extension['scope']==SCOPE,
         'whole first prerequisite epoch plus independently authenticated exact input extension')
    need(qualified['scope']==SCOPE and qualified['revision']==REVISION,'complete fixed source-value qualification epoch')
    need(set(qualified['fixed'])=={str(p) for p in fixed_inputs()},'whole fixed source-value input population')
    for path in fixed_inputs():
        command=['git','--no-replace-objects','show',REVISION+':'+str(path)]
        actual=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True)
        need(actual.returncode==0 and actual.stderr==b'' and actual.stdout==path.read_bytes()
             and same(qualified['fixed'][str(path)],dict(command=command,status=0,identity=pin(actual.stdout))),
             'whole fixed/current complete source-value input')
    readers=prerequisites.readers()
    need(set(qualified['readers'])==set(readers),'complete actual prerequisite reader set')
    for name,args in readers.items():
        item=qualified['readers'][name];record=load(item['receipt'])
        context='complete fixed committed inputs' if 'dated-publication' in name else 'current fixed source inputs'
        need(item['context']==context and record['command']==['python3','-B',*args]
             and type(record['status']) is int and record['status']==0 and record['stderr']=='' and 'PASS ' in record['stdout']
             and item['identity']==pin(canonical(record)),'whole actual fresh prerequisite and proper publication context')
    command=['python3','-B',str(BOUNDARY/'verify.py')]
    actual=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
    need(type(actual.returncode) is int and actual.returncode==0 and actual.stderr=='' and actual.stdout.startswith('PASS '),
         'fresh complete current child and dated-publication custody replay')
    return dict(command=command,status=actual.returncode,stdout=actual.stdout,stderr=actual.stderr,
                program=pin((BOUNDARY/'verify.py').read_bytes()))
